rv.q: Attached with body cords, the two actors lunge, parry and riposte with convincing credibility.
The dialogue is crisp and fast-paced.
Still, most of the time, their conversations feel awkward and tedious and don't allow you to connect with the characters, causing you to drift off and fail to keep your interest.
I feel it is one to see and if you have teenagers who compete in sports, you might want to ask them to join you.

cn.t: Critics find this intimate two-hander about competitive teen fencers perceptive and well-performed, though not essential viewing. Strong performances and direction elevate a story that effectively uses fencing as metaphor for friendship and rivalry.
